statement: ICE Brent front-month crude settles at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-14.
resolution: TRUE if any ICE Brent front-month official daily settlement reported by ICE or major financial press between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-14 is 100.00 USD or higher; else FALSE.

statement: The S&P 500 closes at or below 7000 on at least one trading day between 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the official S&P 500 closing level reported by major financial press is 7000 or lower on any trading day between 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-30; else FALSE.

statement: The United States 10-year Treasury yield closes at or above 5.00 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the daily closing 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield reported by the US Treasury or major financial press reaches 5.00 percent or higher on any trading day in the window; else FALSE.

statement: At least two independent wire services report a new US or Israeli military strike on Iranian territory or Iranian-flagged maritime assets between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-24.
resolution: TRUE if two or more of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, or Al Jazeera publish reports of a new strike on Iranian territory or Iranian-flagged vessels dated within the window; else FALSE.

statement: The United States and Iran publicly announce a ceasefire or formal cessation of hostilities between 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if both governments, or a joint statement, publicly confirm a ceasefire or cessation of hostilities reported by major press within the window; else FALSE.

statement: The French national government formally declares a nationwide state of emergency for the wildfires between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-10.
resolution: TRUE if the French national government formally declares a nationwide state of emergency covering the wildfires, reported by two independent wire services within the window; else FALSE.

statement: The UK Ministry of Defence publicly confirms deployment of military assets to assist wildfire suppression in Scotland between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-07.
resolution: TRUE if the UK MoD or Scottish Government confirms deployment of military personnel or aircraft to the Cairngorms wildfire, reported by major press within the window; else FALSE.

statement: CISA adds a Fastjson or GitLab remote-code-execution CVE to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: TRUE if a Fastjson-related or GitLab-related CVE appears in the CISA KEV catalog with a date-added value within the window; else FALSE.

statement: Iranian state broadcaster IRIB airs the full presidential speech it was reported to have censored, with resolution of the dispute confirmed, between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-15.
resolution: TRUE if Al Jazeera, Reuters, or AP report that IRIB broadcast the previously withheld speech or that the government-broadcaster dispute was formally resolved within the window; else FALSE.

statement: A US federal court or the Supreme Court issues a ruling in a challenge to Trump administration tariffs between 2026-07-27 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if a US federal court or the Supreme Court issues a merits ruling on the legality of any Trump administration tariff, reported by major press within the window; else FALSE.
